Payload.$Comment: III keeps player/group scaling ON (unlike I and II, which turn scaling off entirely); only distance escalation is switched off here. The pattern core is the longest of the three, so a world matching all of them lands on this rule. Add "GameplayConfig": ["YourKey"] beside the pattern if your instance authors one - that axis outranks every name pattern and never changes when the instance is rebuilt. PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is pinned to 0 so the group delta applies from the first block of the instance - the global newcomer ring is measured from world spawn and would otherwise cover the whole dungeon.
